40010218.author: पदार्थः
40010218.content: नरेन्द्रसूनुः son of a king, सः he, रामानुजः Rama's younger brother, कामिनम् lovesick, दीनम् dejected, अदीनसत्त्वम् indomitable hero, शोकाभिपन्नम् overcome by grief, समुदीर्णकोपम् very angry, नरदेवपुत्रम् son of lord of the people, अग्रजम् elder brother, इति this, उवाच spoke.

40010218.author: Translation
40010218.content: Seeing the indomitable hero, his elder brother, son of a king, lovesick, dejected and overcome by anger and grief, spoke prince Lakshmana:

40010219.author: पदार्थः
40010219.content: वानरः monkey (Sugriva), साधुवृत्ते well conducted, स्थास्यति abide, कर्मफलानुषङ्गान् sharing fruits of action equally, मंस्यते not recognised, वानरराज्यलक्ष्मीम् prosperous kingship of the monkeys, न भोज्यते not enjoy, तथाहि hence, अस्य his, बुद्धिः intellect, नाभिक्रमते not conducted in our favour (search of Sita)

40010219.author: Translation
40010219.content: 'Sugriva has not stuck to the conduct of the virtuous, of sharing the fruits of action equally. He does not realize that he obtained the prosperous kingship of vanaras as a result of your (friendly) action. He does not have the intelligence of conducting himself in your favour (of searching Sita). Therefore he will not enjoy the kingship for long.

40010220.author: पदार्थः
40010220.content: वीर hero, तव your, प्रसादाप्रतिकारबुद्धिः ingratitude to the benefactor, मतिक्षयात् mind grown smaller, ग्राम्यसुखेषु in rustic, vulgar pleasures, सक्तः engaged, हतः killed, अग्रजम् elder brother, तस्य his, पश्यतु let him see, एवम् that way, विगुणस्य desttitute of virtues, राज्यम् kingdom, न देयम् not to be given.

40010220.author: Translation
40010220.content: 'O hero he is too ungrateful to return the favour done to him, Engaged in rustic, vulgar pleasures, he is not thinking of it. Let him see his killed elder brother. Kingship should not be given to an individual who is a destitute of virtues.

40010221.author: पदार्थः
40010221.content: उदीर्णवेगम् overflow, कोपम् anger, न धारये I do not hold, अद्य now, असत्यम् untruthful, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, निहन्मि kill, वालिपुत्रः Vali's son, हरिप्रवीरैः with foremost of monkeys, सह along with, नरेन्द्रपत्न्याः queen, विचयम् search, करोतु let him make.

40010221.author: Translation
40010221.content: 'I cannot hold my overflowing anger. I shall kill this untruthful Sugriva. Let Vali's son along with the foremost of monkeys search for the queen (Sita).'

40010222.author: पदार्थः
40010222.content: परवीरहन्ता a slayer of enemy heroes, रामः Rama, निवेदितार्थम् who seek refuge, रणचण्डकोपम् fierce in war, आत्तबाणासनम् wielding bow and arrow, उत्पतन्तम् suddenly standing up, तम् him, स्ववेक्षितम् his own angle of vision, सानुनयं च in a conciliatory tone, वाक्यम् these words, उवाच spoke.

40010222.author: Translation
40010222.content: Rama, a slayer of enemy heroes but not of those who seek his refuge, spoke in a conciliatory tone to Lakshmana who jumped, wielding bow and arrows, inspired with his fierce fighting spirit.

40010223.author: पदार्थः
40010223.content: त्वद्विधः a man like you, लोके in the world, एवम् in this way, पापम् sin, न समाचरेत् not commit, यः whoever, आर्येण of noble attitude, (कोपम् anger), हन्ति kills, सः वीरः such a hero, पुरुषोत्तमः best of men

40010223.author: Translation
40010223.content: A man like you would not commit such a sin in this world; he who destroys evil by noble means is a true hero, the best of men.

40010224.author: पदार्थः
40010224.content: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, साधुवृत्तेन with good conduct, त्वया by you, अत्र here, इदम् thus, ग्राह्यम् keeping, ताम् that, प्रीतिम् affection, पूर्ववृत्तम् as earlier, सङ्गतं च also friendship, अनुवर्तस्व follow.

40010224.author: Translation
40010224.content: 'O Lakshmana with your good conduct you should not do so.  Keeping in view the affectionate friendship extended (by Sugriva) earlier, be friendly.

40010225.author: पदार्थः
40010225.content: कालपर्यये not attempting timely action, व्यतीतम् who exceeded, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, रूक्षाणि harsh, परिवर्जयन् avoiding, सामोपहितया adopting conciliating, वाचा with word, वक्तुम् to speak, अर्हसि proper for you.

40010225.author: Translation
40010225.content: 'Sugriva has exceeded the time limit. Avoiding harsh words, you ought to speak to him in a conciliatory manner.

40010226.author: पदार्थः
40010226.content: अग्रजेन by the elder brother, यथावत् duly, अनुशिष्टार्थः briefed, पुरुषर्षभः bull among men, परवीरहा destroyer of enemies, वीरः hero, सः लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, पुरीम् city, प्रविवेश entered.

40010226.author: Translation
40010226.content: Having been duly briefed by his elder brother, the heroic Lakshmana, destroyer of enemies, a bull among men entered the city.

40010227.author: पदार्थः
40010227.content: ततः then, शुभमतिः good hearted man, प्राज्ञ: wise man, प्रियहिते benevolent person, रतः involved, प्रतिसम्रब्धः eager to please, कालान्तकोपमः resembling the anger of the god of death, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, शक्रबाणासनप्रख्यम् comparable to the bow of Indra, गिरिशृङ्गाभम् like a mountain peak, धनुः bow, प्रगृह्य holding, मन्दरः Mandara, सानुमानिव like mountain peak, कपेः monkey's, भवनम् to the mansion, जगाम went.

40010227.author: Translation
40010227.content: The noblehearted, benevolent and wise Lakshmana, eager to please Rama, picked up his bow looking like a mountain peak, comparable to the bow of Indra and agitated with the anger of the god of Death entered the mansion of Sugriva which stood like the mountain peak of Mandara.

40010228.author: पदार्थः
40010228.content: ततः then, शुभमतिः good hearted man, प्राज्ञ: wise man, प्रियहिते benevolent person, रतः involved, प्रतिसम्रब्धः eager to please, कालान्तकोपमः resembling the anger of the god of death, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, शक्रबाणासनप्रख्यम् comparable to the bow of Indra, गिरिशृङ्गाभम् like a mountain peak, धनुः bow, प्रगृह्य holding, मन्दरः Mandara, सानुमानिव like mountain peak, कपेः monkey's, भवनम् to the mansion, जगाम went.

40010228.author: Translation
40010228.content: The noblehearted, benevolent and wise Lakshmana, eager to please Rama, picked up his bow looking like a mountain peak, comparable to the bow of Indra and agitated with the anger of the god of Death entered the mansion of Sugriva which stood like the mountain peak of Mandara.

40010229.author: पदार्थः
40010229.content: तदा then, यथोक्तकारी obedient, रामानुजः Rama's younger brother, भ्रातुः brother's, कामक्रोधसमुत्थेन inspired by love and anger, कोपाग्निना by the fire of anger, वृतः encompassed, अप्रीतः displeased, बुद्ध्या in his mind, बृहस्पतिसमः like Brihaspati, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, सोत्तरम् answer to be given, उत्तरं वचनम् words of reply, मत्वा thinking over, तदा then, प्रभञ्जन इव like stormy wind, प्रययौ marched.

40010229.author: Translation
40010229.content: Then Lakshmana, obedient, intelligent like Brihaspati, like a tempest, encompassed by the fire of anger and deliberating in his mind as to the possible questions from Sugriva and the reply from him.

40010230.author: पदार्थः
40010230.content: तदा then, यथोक्तकारी obedient, रामानुजः Rama's younger brother, भ्रातुः brother's, कामक्रोधसमुत्थेन inspired by love and anger, कोपाग्निना by the fire of anger, वृतः encompassed, अप्रीतः displeased, बुद्ध्या in his mind, बृहस्पतिसमः like Brihaspati, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, सोत्तरम् answer to be given, उत्तरं वचनम् words of reply, मत्वा thinking over, तदा then, प्रभञ्जन इव like stormy wind, प्रययौ marched.

40010230.author: Translation
40010230.content: Then Lakshmana, obedient, intelligent like Brihaspati, like a tempest, encompassed by the fire of anger and deliberating in his mind as to the possible questions from Sugriva and the reply from him.

40010231.author: पदार्थः
40010231.content: आशुगः swift, गज इव like an elephant, वेगतः speedily, तरसा vigorously, सालतालाश्वकर्णांश्च sala, tala, and asvakarna, पातयन् felling trees, अन्यान् and others, द्रुमांश्च trees, गिरिकूटानि mountain rocks, बलात् forcibly, पर्यस्यन् turning them, पद्भ्याम् with his feet, शिलाः rocks, शकलीकुर्वन् breaking to pieces, दूरम् a distance, एकपदे with one foot, त्यक्त्वा pushing, कार्यवशात् to carry out the task, द्रुतम् quickly, ययौ went.

40010231.author: Translation
40010231.content: 'Lakshmana rushed on foot speedily, cutting the branches of sala, tala and asvakarna and other trees on the way  and forcibly turning and crushing the mountain rocks into pieces with a single foot, like a swiftmoving elephant taking long strides, to carry out the task.

40010232.author: पदार्थः
40010232.content: आशुगः swift, गज इव like an elephant, वेगतः speedily, तरसा vigorously, सालतालाश्वकर्णांश्च sala, tala, and asvakarna, पातयन् felling trees, अन्यान् and others, द्रुमांश्च trees, गिरिकूटानि mountain rocks, बलात् forcibly, पर्यस्यन् turning them, पद्भ्याम् with his feet, शिलाः rocks, शकलीकुर्वन् breaking to pieces, दूरम् a distance, एकपदे with one foot, त्यक्त्वा pushing, कार्यवशात् to carry out the task, द्रुतम् quickly, ययौ went.

40010232.author: Translation
40010232.content: 'Lakshmana rushed on foot speedily, cutting the branches of sala, tala and asvakarna and other trees on the way  and forcibly turning and crushing the mountain rocks into pieces with a single foot, like a swiftmoving elephant taking long strides, to carry out the task.

40010233.author: पदार्थः
40010233.content: इक्ष्वाकुशार्दूलः tiger of the Ikshvaku race, गिरिसङ्कटे in between the mountains, बलाकीर्णाम् filled by the army, दुर्गाम् inaccessible, हरिराजमहापुरीम् vanara king's capital city, ताम् that, किष्किन्धाम् Kishkinda, अपश्यत् saw.

40010233.author: Translation
40010233.content: The tiger of the Ikshvaku race saw the inaccessible Kishkinda, the capital of vanara kingdom, located between mountains and fortified with the army.

40010234.author: पदार्थः
40010234.content: सुग्रीवम् प्रति Sugriva in turn, रोषात् due to anger, प्रस्फुरमाणोष्ठः lips trembling, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, किष्किन्धायाः Kishkinda's, बहिश्चरान् front guards, भीमान् fierceful ones, वानरान् monkeys, ददर्श saw.

40010234.author: Translation
40010234.content: His lips trembling in anger, Lakshmana saw fierceful monkey guards of Sugriva at the entrance of Kishkinda city.

40010235.author: पदार्थः
40010235.content: पर्वतान्तरे in between the mountains, कुञ्जरप्रख्याः comparable to elephants in size, सर्वे all, वानराः monkeys, पुरुषर्षभम् bull among men, तं लक्ष्मणम् that Lakshmana, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, शतशः in hundreds, शैलशृङ्गाणि boulders of rocks, प्रवृद्धान् fully grown, महीरुहान् च huge trees, जगृहुः seized.

40010235.author: Translation
40010235.content: Hundreds of monkeys of the size of elephants stood holding huge trees and boulders of rocks on seeing Lakshmana, the bull among men.

40010236.author: पदार्थः
40010236.content: लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, गृहीतप्रहरणान् seized weapons, तान् them, हरीन् monkeys, दृष्ट्वा on seeing, बह्विन्धनः lots of firewood, अनलः इव like fire, द्विगुणम् doubled, क्रुद्धः angry, बभूव became.

40010236.author: Translation
40010236.content: On seeing the monkeys wielding weapons, Lakshmana's anger doubled like logs of firewood put to burning.

40010237.author: पदार्थः
40010237.content: शतशः in hundreds, ते they, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, क्रुद्धम्  enraged, कालमृत्युयुगान्ताभम् seemed like the god of death at the end of creation, तम् him, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, भयपरीताङ्गाः limbs shaking in fear, दिशः directions, विद्रुताः fled.

40010237.author: Translation
40010237.content: Seeing enraged Lakshmana, who looked like a veritable god of Death at the time of dissolution of the universe, hundreds of monkeys, their limbs trembling in fear ran in different directions.

40010238.author: पदार्थः
40010238.content: ततः then, हरिपुङ्गवा: monkeychiefs, सुग्रीवभवनम् to Sugriva's mansion, प्रविश्य having entered, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, आगमनम् about the arrival, क्रोधं चैव and his anger, न्यवेदयन् reported.

40010238.author: Translation
40010238.content: Having entered Sugriva's palace, the monkeychiefs reported the arrival of angry Lakshmana.

40010239.author: पदार्थः
40010239.content: तदा then, कामी passionate, तारया with Tara, सहितः along with, रहः in privy, सक्तः engrossed in love, कपिवृषः bull among monkeys, तेषाम् their, कपिवीराणाम् of the monkeychiefs, वचनम् words, न शुश्राव not heed.

40010239.author: Translation
40010239.content: But Sugriva who was engrossed in overtures with passionate Tara, did not heed the words of the monkeychiefs.

40010240.author: पदार्थः
40010240.content: ततः then, रोमहर्षणाः who causes horripilation, गिरिकुञ्जरमेघाभाः fierceful like the mountains, elephants and clouds, हरयः the monkeys, सचिवसन्दिष्टाः commaded by the ministers, तदा then, नगरात् from the city, निर्ययुः they left.

40010240.author: Translation
40010240.content: Commanded by the ministers, the monkeys who looked like fierce mountains, elephants and clouds that caused horripilation, left the place at once.

40010241.author: पदार्थः
40010241.content: घोरा: dreadful, नखदंष्ट्रायुधाः nails and teeth as weapons, सर्वे all, विकृतदर्शनाः horrifying to look, सर्वे all, शार्दूलदर्पा: proud as tigers, सर्वे च and all, विकृताननाः of deformed faces.

40010241.author: Translation
40010241.content: The monkeys, their faces, deformed, their nails and teeth like weapons were dreadful and horrifying in appearance, proud as tigers

40010242.author: पदार्थः
40010242.content: केचित् some, दशनागबलाः possessed the strength of ten elephants, केचित् some, दशगुणोत्तराः of a hundred elephants in strength, केचित् some, नागसहस्रस्य of a thousand elephants in strength, तुल्यविक्रमाः equal in valour, बभूवुः were.

40010242.author: Translation
40010242.content: Of them some possessed the strength of ten, some a hundred and some a thousand elephants. All of them were of equal valour.

40010243.author: पदार्थः
40010243.content: कृत्स्नां entire palace, क्रुद्धः angry, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, द्रुमहस्तै: holding trees in hands, महाबलैः mighty strong, कपिभिः monkeys, व्याप्ताम् huge, दुरासदाम् inaccessible, तां किष्किन्धाम् that Kishkinda, अपश्यत् saw.

40010243.author: Translation
40010243.content: Enraged Lakshmana saw the huge inacccessible city of Kishkinda filled with  mighty strong and fierce monkeys holding trees in hand.

40010244.author: पदार्थः
40010244.content: ततः then, उदग्रसत्त्वाः with marked strength, सर्वे all, ते हरयः the monkeys, प्राकारपरिघान्तरात् crossing the ironboundary from beneath, निष्क्रम्य came out, तदा then, अविष्कृतम्  made their appearance, तस्थुः stood.

40010244.author: Translation
40010244.content: The mighty monkeys came out of the entrance of the ironboundary wall from beneath and made their appearance and stood in full attention.

40010245.author: पदार्थः
40010245.content: आत्मवान् sensible, सः वीरः that warrior, सुग्रीवस्य Sugriva's, प्रमादम् dereliction, पूर्वजं च and his elder brother, आर्तम् helpless, बुद्ध्वा  recognising, पुनरेव once again, क्रोधवशम् under the grip of anger, जगाम was drawn.

40010245.author: Translation
40010245.content: The sensible warrior, recognising Sugriva's dereliction of duty and his own brother's agony once again flew into fury.

40010246.author: पदार्थः
40010246.content: दीर्घोष्णमहोच्छवासः sighing with hot deep breath, कोपसंरक्तलोचनः with his eyes turned red out of anger, नरशार्दूलः tiger among men, सः he, सधूमः with smoke, पावकः इव like fire, बभूव appeared.

40010246.author: Translation
40010246.content: Sighing hot, deep breath, eyes turned red in anger, this tiger among men appeared like fire with smoke (The sigh was smoke and red eyes, fire).

40010247.author: पदार्थः
40010247.content: बाणशल्यस्फुरज्जिह्वः the iron nails fixed on the arrows as moving fangs, सायकासनभोगवान् bow as the snake, स्वतेजोविषसङ्घातः his own brightness as poison, पञ्चास्यः fivehooded, पन्नगः इव snake like.

40010247.author: Translation
40010247.content: His bow was like the hood of a snake,with the iron nails fixed on the tip of his arrows like moving fangs and his own brightness like the venom of the fivehooded snake.

40010248.author: पदार्थः
40010248.content: अङ्गदः Angada, दीप्तम् glowing, कालाग्निम् इव like fire at the dissolution of the world, कोपितम् enraged, नागेन्द्रमिव like lord of snakes, तम् him, समासाद्य on nearing, त्रासात् with fear, भृशम् greatly, विषादम् worry, अगमत् felt.

40010248.author: Translation
40010248.content: Dismayed, Angada approached Lakshmana, who was glowing like fire at the time of dissolution of the world and enraged like the lord of serpents.

40010249.author: पदार्थः
40010249.content: रोषताम्राक्षः eyes red with anger, महायशाः renowned, सः he, अङ्गदम् to Angada, वत्स child, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, मम about my, आगमनम् arrival, कथ्यताम्  inform, इति उत thus, सन्दिदेश sent word.

40010249.author: Translation
40010249.content: Renowned Lakshmana, with his eyes turned red in anger said to Angada 'O dear, inform Sugriva, about my arrival'.

40010250.author: पदार्थः
40010250.content: अरिन्दम O subduer of enemies, वत्स dear, भ्रातुः brother's, व्यसनसन्तप्तः burning in grief, रामानुजः Rama's younger brother, एषः लक्ष्मणः this Lakshmana, त्वत्सकाशम् to your presence, प्राप्तः arrived, द्वारि at the entrance, तिष्ठति stands, वानर Vanara, रुचिः यदि if you like, तस्य his, वाक्ये words, साधु well, क्रियताम् do accordingly, इति thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, शीघ्रम् swiftly, आगच्छ come.

40010250.author: Translation
40010250.content: 'O subduer of enemies speak in this way: 'Lakshmana, the dear younger brother of Rama has come to you and waits for your presence at the entrance, burning in grief of his elder brother. Well, if you like to hear his words, do as you please.' 'Return swiftly after saying so.'

40010251.author: पदार्थः
40010251.content: अरिन्दम O subduer of enemies, वत्स dear, भ्रातुः brother's, व्यसनसन्तप्तः burning in grief, रामानुजः Rama's younger brother, एषः लक्ष्मणः this Lakshmana, त्वत्सकाशम् to your presence, प्राप्तः arrived, द्वारि at the entrance, तिष्ठति stands, वानर Vanara, रुचिः यदि if you like, तस्य his, वाक्ये words, साधु well, क्रियताम् do accordingly, इति thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, शीघ्रम् swiftly, आगच्छ come.

40010251.author: Translation
40010251.content: 'O subduer of enemies speak in this way: 'Lakshmana, the dear younger brother of Rama has come to you and waits for your presence at the entrance, burning in grief of his elder brother. Well, if you like to hear his words, do as you please.' 'Return swiftly after saying so.'

40010252.author: पदार्थः
40010252.content: लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, शोकाविष्ट: griefstricken, अङ्गदः Angada, पितुः father's, समीपम् near, आगम्य reached, अयम् this, सौमित्रिः Saumitri, आगतः has come, अब्रवीत् said.

40010252.author: Translation
40010252.content: On hearing Lakshmana's words Angada became sad. He approached his father (Sugriva) and said 'Saumitri has come'. (This sloka appears an interpolation).

40010253.author: पदार्थः
40010253.content: अथ then, तरस्वी powerful, अङ्गदः Angada, तस्य his, वच: word, निशम्य on hearing, सम्भ्रान्तभावः agitated in mind, परदीनवक्त्रः face turned pale, निपत्य prostrating, तूर्णं at once, नृपतेः king's, ततः then, रुमायाः Ruma's, चरणौ feet, ववन्दे offered salutations.

40010253.author: Translation
40010253.content: On hearing Lakshmana's words powerful Angada felt agitated. His face turned pale. He went and prostrated at once to the king and then to the queen, Ruma.

40010254.author: पदार्थः
40010254.content: अग्रतेजाः highly brilliant Angada, पितुः father's, पादौ feet, सङ्गृह्य holding, पुनरेव again, मातुः mother's, पादौ feet, जग्राह held, रुमायाः Ruma's, पादौ च feet, निपीडयित्वा pressing, तमर्थम् the message, ततः then, निवेदयामास revealed.

40010254.author: Translation
40010254.content: Highly brilliant Angada holding his father's feet first, then mother's and thereafter Ruma's, reported the matter to  Sugriva.

40010255.author: पदार्थः
40010255.content: निद्रामदसंवीतः overcome by drinks and sleep, वानरः monkey, न विबुद्धवान् he did not come to his senses, मदमत्तश्च intoxicated, मदनेन च overwhelmed by love, मोहितः deluded, बभूव appeared.

40010255.author: Translation
40010255.content: The monkey was too drowsy with drink, too intoxicated with passion to come back to his senses.

40010256.author: पदार्थः
40010256.content: ततः then, क्रुद्धम् angry, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, प्रेक्ष्य  looking, वानराः monkeys, भयमोहितचेतसः feeling scared at heart, तम् them, प्रसादयन्तः  pleasing him, किलकिलाम् चक्रुः made a noise.

40010256.author: Translation
40010256.content: Looking at angry Lakshmana, and scared at heart, the monkeys started making a noise in order to please him.

40010257.author: पदार्थः
40010257.content: ते they, दृष्ट्वा  seeing, महौघनिभम् looked like a mighty flood, वज्राशनिसमस्वनम् noise like a thunderbolt, सिंहनादम् lion's roar, समम् like, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, समीपतः near, चक्रुः made.

40010257.author: Translation
40010257.content: They saw Lakshmana advancing like a mighty flood and went near him making sounds like the thunderbolt or a lion.

40010258.author: पदार्थः
40010258.content: महता by the great, तेन शब्देन by that sound, वानरः monkey, मदविह्वलताम्राक्षः having red eyes due to intoxication, व्याकुलस्रग्विभूषणः ornaments and garlands in disarry, प्रत्यबुध्यत awakened.

40010258.author: Translation
40010258.content: By the great sound (of the monkeys) the drunken redeyed vanara king awakened, his garlands and ornaments in disarray.

40010259.author: पदार्थः
40010259.content: अथ then, अङ्गदवचः Angada's words, श्रुत्वा hearing, तेनैव along with him, समागतौ both of them assembled, सम्मतौ दारदर्शिनौ both of them permitted to have audience with womenfolk, अर्थधर्मयोः in matters of wealth and righteousness, मन्त्रिणौ ministers, प्लक्षश्चैव Plaksha and, प्रभावश्च Prabhava also, तौ both, वानरेन्द्रस्य the king's, मन्त्रिणौ both ministers, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana's, प्राप्तम् arrived, वक्तुम् to tell, उच्चावचम् to talk , शंसतुः both of them spoke.

40010259.author: Translation
40010259.content: On hearing Angada's words the two ministers named Plaksha and Prabhava who were perrmitted to have audience with the queens went to the harem on invitation from Angada. They reported to Sugriva about the arrival of Lakshmana who had come to speak to him about matters regading wealth and righteousness.

40010260.author: पदार्थः
40010260.content: अथ then, अङ्गदवचः Angada's words, श्रुत्वा hearing, तेनैव along with him, समागतौ both of them assembled, सम्मतौ दारदर्शिनौ both of them permitted to have audience with womenfolk, अर्थधर्मयोः in matters of wealth and righteousness, मन्त्रिणौ ministers, प्लक्षश्चैव Plaksha and, प्रभावश्च Prabhava also, तौ both, वानरेन्द्रस्य the king's, मन्त्रिणौ both ministers, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana's, प्राप्तम् arrived, वक्तुम् to tell, उच्चावचम् to talk , शंसतुः both of them spoke.

40010260.author: Translation
40010260.content: On hearing Angada's words the two ministers named Plaksha and Prabhava who were perrmitted to have audience with the queens went to the harem on invitation from Angada. They reported to Sugriva about the arrival of Lakshmana who had come to speak to him about matters regading wealth and righteousness.

40010261.author: पदार्थः
40010261.content: आसीनम् seated, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, मरुत्पतिम् lord of Maruts, शक्रं यथा like Indra, पर्युपासीनौ both seated close, सामनिश्चितैः by conciliatory words, वचनैः with words, प्रसादयित्वा after pleasing.

40010261.author: Translation
40010261.content: Both of them sat close by Sugriva who was like Indra and said these pleasing words:

40010262.author: पदार्थः
40010262.content: सत्यसन्धौ both true to their promise, महाभागौ both venerable, राज्यार्हौ  deserving kingdom, राज्यदायिनौ have given sovereignty, भ्रातरौ two brothers, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, वयस्यभावम् friendship, सम्प्राप्तौ extended .

40010262.author: Translation
40010262.content: 'Rama and Lakshmana, both the brothers venerable and true to their promise, have conferred on you sovereignty and have extended friendship.'

40010263.author: पदार्थः
40010263.content: तयोः between the two, एकः only, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, धनुष्पाणिः wielding a bow in his hand, द्वारि at the entrance, तिष्ठति is standing, यस्य his, भीताः frightened ones, प्रवेपन्तः are trembling, वानराः monkeys, नादान् sounds, मुञ्चन्ति are producing.

40010263.author: Translation
40010263.content: 'Of the two, only Lakshmana is standing at the entrance wielding his bow in hand. The monkeys are trembling in fear and running about, making a loud noise'.

40010264.author: पदार्थः
40010264.content: तस्य his, रामस्य Rama's, शासनात् by the command, राघवभ्राता Rama's brother, सः एषः लक्ष्मणः that Lakshmna, वाक्यसारथिः his words as a charioteer, व्यवसायरथः his work a chariot, पाप्तः has come.

40010264.author: Translation
40010264.content: 'By the command of Rama, his brother has come to you, Rama's words as charioteer and his work as chariot'.

40010265.author: पदार्थः
40010265.content: अनघ O sinless one, राजन् O king, तारायाः Tara's, तनय: son, दयितः dear one, अयं अङ्गदः this Angada, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, त्वरया at once, ते सकाशम् to your presence, प्रेषितः is sent to you.

40010265.author: Translation
40010265.content: 'O blameless king Tara's son, Angada, has sent us into your presence. Lakshmana has come.'

40010266.author: पदार्थः
40010266.content: वानरपते O lord of vanaras, वीर्यवान् valiant, अयम् this person, रोषपरीताक्षः angereyed, चक्षुषा with his eyes, वानरान् monkeys, प्रदहन्निव as if burning, द्वारि at the entrance, तिष्ठति is waiting.

40010266.author: Translation
40010266.content: 'O lord of monkeys Valiant Lakshmana is standing at the entrance,eyes filled with anger as if he would burn the vanaras'.

40010267.author: पदार्थः
40010267.content: महाराज O great king, त्वम् you, सपुत्रः with your son, सहबान्धवः with your relations, शीघ्रम् quickly, गच्छ go, मूर्ध्ना face, तस्य his, प्रणम्य after saluting, अद्य now, रोषः anger, निवर्त्यताम् may be averted.

40010267.author: Translation
40010267.content: 'O great king Go at once with your son and relations, salute him now and avert his anger'.

40010268.author: पदार्थः
40010268.content: राजन् O king, धर्मात्मा righteous, रामः Rama, यत् whatever, आह says तत् that, समाहितः with a steady mind, कुरुष्व  you may do, सत्यप्रतिश्रवाः be true to your promise, स्वसमये your agreement, भव you.

40010268.author: Translation
40010268.content: 'O king be true to your promise to his brother, righteous Rama without fail. Honour the agreement.' इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे एकत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyfirst sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic, composed by sage Valmiki.
